title: Trigger comment (map/triggers/**/*.comment.json)
description: A comment item of a Reforged trigger tree (docs/trigger-folders-spec.md, section 3C), read and written by crates/w3proj/src/trigger_layout.rs. Unknown keys are errors there, so they are refused here too.

description.description: the comment's text; empty when missing

enabled.description: true when missing; written only when false

isCustom.description: false when missing; written only when true

initiallyOff.description: false when missing; written only when true

runOnInit.description: false when missing; written only when true

ecas.description: what an imported comment item carries, kept; none when missing

text.description: a name or value war3map.wtg stores: no zero character
